documents.title: Get access to a SharePoint site · Steps
documents.text:
## Steps
Open the site link and click **Request access**. The site owner gets an email and usually approves within one working day. The help desk cannot add you to a site without the owner's approval.

documents.title: Install software that is not in the portal · Steps
documents.text:
## Steps
Most approved software is in the software portal and installs without admin rights. For anything else, raise a software request with the name, version and business reason. Security reviews new software within three working days.

documents.title: VPN client troubleshooting policy (2024) · Notes
documents.text:
## Notes
Reinstalling clears cached certificates. Expect to sign in again with MFA.

documents.title: Bluetooth headset will not pair · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
Forget the headset in Bluetooth settings, put it into pairing mode (usually hold the power button for 5 seconds), and pair again. Keep it within one metre of the laptop while pairing.

documents.title: Outlook for Mac not syncing · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
1. Check you are online and not in **Work Offline** mode (Outlook menu).
2. Go to **Outlook > Settings > Accounts**, select your account and choose **Repair**.
3. If mail is still missing, remove the account and add it again with your work email.

documents.title: Teams calls with no sound · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
1. In Teams, open **Settings > Devices** and choose the right speaker and microphone.
2. Make a test call from the same page.
3. Unplug and replug the headset, then select it again.
4. On a Mac, check **System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone** allows Teams.

documents.title: OneDrive sync paused or stuck · Fix
documents.text:
## Fix
1. Click the OneDrive cloud icon and choose **Resume syncing**.
2. If files show a red cross, check the file name has no unsupported characters and the path is under 400 characters.
3. If sync is still stuck, choose **Settings > Account > Unlink this PC/Mac** and sign in again. Files already synced stay on the device.

documents.title: VPN drops every few minutes on macOS · Fix: reset the VPN profile
documents.text:
## Fix: reset the VPN profile
1. Click the Northwind VPN icon in the menu bar and choose **Disconnect**.
2. Choose **Settings > Reset profile**. Your saved server list is rebuilt; you do not need to reinstall anything.
3. Reconnect and sign in with your work account and MFA.
Most people are stable again within a minute. The reset does not need admin rights.
